props.description: Cycle counts for optimizing inventory movements. Cycle parameters are the filters used to query the system for inventory that should be counted - all parameters are "OR" statements. Any inventory matching any of the parameters will be included in the count.

Count lines are the aggregated expectations for the count based upon the dimensions/parameters provided when the count was defined. Each line represents a single product, in a single location with the expected quantity and weight to be counted.

props.label: Product
props.description: A human-readable and unique shorthand name for the product

props.label: Expected Quantity
props.description: Expected Quantity is calculated sum at the time the count is 'started'. This defaults to 0 upon initial creation.

props.label: Expected Weight
props.description: expected weight to be counted for this product in this location.

An individual line item for a specific inventory in a larger collection of line items called a "Count" (aka Cycle Count). A record in this table represents the measurement of a single inventory record that corresponds with a single count.

props.label: Serial Number
props.description: A unique number identifying this inventory - maybe a Lot or Serial. This will be used to set the Id field - using a system trigger.

props.label: Counted Quantity
props.description: counted Quantity; should default to the inventory.quantity - unless the user enters a different quantity during the counting process.

props.label: Expected Weight
props.description: gross weight of this inventory - quantity*product.weight + packaging.tareWeight

props.label: Counted Weight
props.description: the weight, of the inventory if doing count by weight.

actions.title: This will require someone to go recount this inventory.
This will exclude this inventory from the this count. It will NOT need to be counted again.
Approving this line of the count will lock it so changes can not be made.
Undo the approval of this line will allow changes to be made.
